title: Sunset Paddling Adventure
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We were founded in 1995, and all our guides are ACA-certified. They are all involved in eco-conservation and education in their spare time, and love to share their knowledge with their guests.
We are the original tour guides in Central Florida, and operate with the commitment to passive observation, education, and conservation.
We don't operate on a corporate model but rather offer an intimate, immersive experience that provides lifelong memories.
